title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
title_zh: Policy-Mask：面向判别任务的预算感知扩散特征适配

paragraphs.en: 提出预算条件策略Policy-Mask，联合选择扩散模型的时间步、块和通道子集，在分割、分类和对应任务上超越基线。 Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-$Σ$ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 提出预算条件策略 Policy-Mask，联合选择扩散模型的时间步、块和通道子集，在分割、分类和对应任务上超越基线。从冻结扩散模型中为判别任务选择中间特征并非易事，因为有用信号分布在去噪轨迹、网络深度和通道之中。 在实践中，这需要选择一个时间步、一个块以及一个通道子集。 现有方法要么手工固定这些选择，要么仅优化少数几个特征提取超参数（最常见的是时间步），然后在不同的输入和预算下复用同一规则。 我们提出 Policy-Mask，一种在下游目标上训练的预算条件策略，可在给定的通道预算下联合选择上述三者。 若不进行归一化，通道得分的贡献会随所选通道数量的增加而增长，并主导时间步和块的更新。 我们通过子集基数对其进行归一化，使三个策略头保持在可比的尺度上，从而稳定联合训练。 在相同预算下，Policy-Mask 在分割、分类和语义对应任务上均优于固定特征提取和特征过滤基线，在 ADE20K 上达到 38.9 mIoU，在 128 维下于 CIFAR-100 上达到 75.4% top-1，在 SPair-71k 上达到 76.3 PCK@0.1。 逐组件的消融实验表明，块的选择对下游精度有实质性影响，且记录到的最高通道预算得分出现在保留 256 个通道时，这为紧凑的扩散表示确定了一个实用的运行点。 我们进一步将 Policy-Mask 适配到扩散 Transformer，包括 PixArt-$Σ$ 和 SD3.5 MMDiT，方法是将 U-Net 通道替换为图像词元的隐藏维度。
